notes: The marginal 'Or, through error' was read and set aside (rule 38).

by the hand of the avenger of blood: the ASV writes a word for each morpheme, so בְּיַד is split rather than fused as in JOS.20.2; in the three-level chain the article on דָּם takes the the before avenger and the outer construct יַד takes a supplied one, as rule 29 directs for לְבַב כָּל בְּנֵי הָאָדָם.
כָּל → whosoever is split from the participle, which keeps its own killeth; rule 35's כֹּל אֲשֶׁר fusion does not reach it, since no אֲשֶׁר stands here and each morpheme has an English word.
עָרֵי הַמּוּעָדָה is rendered attributively (rule 28); the phrase's single the stands before the article's own word and is the article's.
